BillingProjectionRequest.description: Unknown fields are refused, so Convex must learn a field before the plane sends it. `overrides.limits` is an object of amounts; null is unlimited.

accountId.description: Must equal the account in the path.

EngineActionResult.description: Upgrade answers `outcome`, retry answers `retried`, delete answers `deprovisioning`.

hostedStorage.description: Null when the instance is gone or someone else hosts the engine.

isLive.description: True while the owner's stream is live.

overdue.description: Past its removeBy date, so it is cleanup to do.

removeBy.description: ISO date by which the flag should be gone.

updatedBy.description: The operator who last changed it.

key.description: A lowercase word, then dot- or dash-separated words.

FeatureFlagRequest.description: The whole definition: a create and an update carry the same shape; the key names the row.

key.description: A lowercase word, then dot- or dash-separated words.

rules.description: Required under state "rules" and refused otherwise.

entitlement.description: A key of the entitlement catalog, as `featureFlags.list` returns it.

HostedStorageOverride.description: A field left out inherits the account's limit; null is unlimited.

actor.description: The operator named on the code.

email.description: The user the code is issued to; they must already have signed in.

actionLabel.description: The link button's text, at most 24 characters; only with a link.

accountId.description: The account the notification is for.

userId.description: The user the notification is for.

link.description: An in-app path starting with "/" or an https:// URL, at most 500 characters.

requestId.description: Makes a repeated request answer the notification already created.

eligible.description: True only when the referred org exists, the referrer has a different org, and both owners verified their email.

referrerAccountId.description: The org the referrer owns; null when they have none.

actor.description: The operator named on the code.

StorageLimitsRequest.description: Replaces the engine's whole override. A field left out inherits the account's limit, null is unlimited, and `{}` clears the override.

actor.description: The operator named on the code.

bearerAuth.description: A per-caller secret of at least 43 characters. Each caller may use only the routes in its scope; any other route answers 403.

info.description: What the internal backoffice reads about users, accounts and engines, and what the maintenance billing process pushes. Servers call it with a per-caller secret; it sends no CORS headers.
